prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE production icon atlas for Elements - Icons. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE; replace its subjects with the subjects specified here.
Rustic, earnest old-fashioned COLOURED WOODCUT. Match the supplied references' warm black, dull ochre, clay/rust red, slate blue, muted olive and creamy carved cuts, but visibly simpler and less polished than the first reference: a small number of broad confident cuts, occasional knife slips, uneven angular contours, slightly crooked handmade things, thin missed patches in ink and colour plates shifted slightly beyond or short of their black outlines. Imperfect registration must look printed, not blurred. No smooth gradients, modeled digital shading, tiny decorative hatching, glossy highlights, outline stickers, cute toy proportions, circular badges, frames or presentation shadows. Humble functional objects, easily recognised at 56 pixels. Natural, clear silhouettes before texture. Transparent outside each object.
EXACTLY FIVE columns and FOUR rows, 20 equal cells, wide 5:4 atlas. Keep every complete subject centered in its own cell with at least 15% TRANSPARENT MARGIN from all cell boundaries; strict grid with clear wide gutters. No labels or numbering, no drawn grid, no text except where explicitly requested. Do not repeat objects from the reference unless listed. Make the states of related objects clearly different, using silhouettes and visible contents.
READING ORDER:
1. Axe: Rough wooden haft with a broad dark stone axe head bound across the end, sharp edge
2. Wheel: Simple wooden spoked wheel alone, slightly irregular circle
3. Wheelset: Two matching wooden wheels joined by a clearly visible axle, no cart bed
4. Handcart: Plain two-wheeled wooden cart with a shallow plank bed and two long handles
5. Footbridge: Simple narrow plank footbridge spanning a small gap, two rope handrails, no landscape
6. Grain mill: Connected undershot paddled waterwheel, two wooden gears and horizontal millstones in a modest open timber frame
7. Weighted seed press: Long plank lever pressing a small seed bag onto a draining bed, heavy round stone weighting its end, collecting bowl below
8. Waterwheel: Vertical wooden paddle wheel on its short axle, eight broad paddles, no jars
9. Millstone: Heavy grey circular grinding stone with a central hole and a few radial grooves
10. Wooden gear: One large plain ochre wooden cogwheel with visibly square teeth and axle hole
11. Mill gearing: Two meshing wooden cogwheels on an open timber support, no millstone or waterwheel
12. Pickaxe: Long plain wooden haft with a dark iron double-ended pointed pick head
13. Iron: Two long dark rectangular metal bars with broad pale edge cuts, no rounded rocks
14. Stone hammer: One rounded river cobble held in a simple loop of binding, NO handle and no axe edge
15. Carving tool: Short stout dark metal workshop chisel with flat striking head and a clear bevelled cutting edge, no knife handle
16. Kiln: Small squat clay-red dome firing kiln with one low black arched opening, no bellows
17. Iron ore: Two irregular dark rocks with visible rust-red mineral seams, distinct from clean metal bars
18. Bellows: Plain pear-shaped leather bellows with two wooden handles and a short nozzle
19. Forge: Modest brick charcoal hearth with attached leather bellows and small dark anvil, no finished tools
20. Nails: Five irregular hand-forged dark nails with broad square heads and pointed ends
Keep the rustic style: fewer broad cuts, slight human errors, unequal line weights, imperfect colour registration and dry ink, rather than meticulous shading. Keep all twenty separate and complete.
